verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships agentic AI (SRE Agent with Skills and connectors), so consuming external MCP servers is a fair axis. However, the evidence only shows PagerDuty acting as an MCP server that exposes its own tools to external clients. The SRE Agent's GitHub and Sentry integrations are first-party connectors, and nothing documents plugging arbitrary MCP servers into PagerDuty.
